audit_findings.title: The full cash add-back may double-count customer prepayments
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; the $1,155.5m bridge add-back at issue equals $8.50/share and 6.8% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Reduces the cash and short-term-investment add-back in the equity bridge to the amount demonstrably available after operating obligations.
audit_findings.evidence: The increase in deferred revenue is primarily driven by payments received in advance of satisfying our performance obligations, offset by $ 2,367.0 million of revenue recognized during 2025 that was included in the deferred revenue balance as of December 31, 2024.
audit_findings.explanation: The possible double count is not yet demonstrated because deferred revenue is not itself a dollar-for-dollar cash restriction and GoDaddy also has prepaid fulfillment costs. However, filed deferred revenue of $3,510.9m exceeds cash of $1,155.5m, so treating every cash dollar as surplus is unsupported. Removing the entire add-back would lower base value from $125.14 to about $116.64 per share and buy-below from $87.60 to about $81.65, a material change in valuation and margin-of-safety levels even though base value would remain above the $101.31 price.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile cash to deferred revenue, $788.4m of prepaid registry fees, registry deposits, payment-processor receivables, merchant-settlement obligations and minimum liquidity; rerun only the equity bridge using demonstrably excess cash.

audit_findings.title: Temporary hedge benefits may be capitalized as permanent owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; filed hedge gains recognized against interest expense were $70.2m in 2025, and $48.3m of total net deferred hedge gains were expected in earnings over the next 12 months at 2026-06-30
audit_findings.mechanism: Changes normalized interest expense retained in equity-level OE and therefore the anchor and every forecast cash flow.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we estimate that $ 54.0 million of net deferred gains related to our designated hedges will be recognized in earnings over the next 12 months.
audit_findings.explanation: The August 2027 hedge expirations are demonstrated, but a valuation error is not: the sustainable interest cost after expiry depends on then-prevailing rates, refinancing terms and replacement hedges. The disclosed hedge amounts are large enough to warrant review, but they mix instruments and accounting effects and do not establish the after-tax OE adjustment or its valuation magnitude.
audit_findings.action: Construct a debt-by-debt interest schedule through and after August 2027, separating interest-rate-swap benefits from offsetting cross-currency entries; calculate sustainable after-tax interest expense and rerun the OE anchor and scenarios if it differs from the embedded cost.

audit_findings.title: Express Mobile is an unrecognized claim ahead of common equity
audit_findings.magnitude: $170.0m reasonably possible loss exclusive of interest; the earlier filed interest request was $87.0m
audit_findings.mechanism: Any final payment is a dollar-for-dollar deduction in the equity bridge rather than a recurring OE expense.
audit_findings.evidence: Because of the current stage of the proceedings, including the absence of a final, non-appealable decision, we have determined that it is not probable that a liability has been incurred, and therefore, no liability was recognized as of December 31, 2025.
audit_findings.explanation: The adverse verdict and absence of a recognized liability are demonstrated, although payment remains contingent on appeal. The district court denied enhanced damages and reversed willfulness. Even using $257.0m—the $170.0m verdict plus the earlier $87.0m interest request—the deduction is about $1.89/share, or 1.5% of base equity value, leaving base value near $123.25 versus the $101.31 price. It therefore does not change the valuation conclusion on the filed scale.
audit_findings.action: Update the bridge when appellate proceedings determine probability or amount; obtain the current prejudgment and post-judgment interest calculation and any insurance or tax recovery before recording a final deduction.

audit_findings.title: Capitalized software and cloud implementation spending may be missing from reinvestment
audit_findings.magnitude: $13.8m in 2025 and $12.8m in 2024; full deductions from those OE observations would reduce the computed trend anchor by about $9.0m and base value by about $1.22/share
audit_findings.mechanism: Adds omitted capitalized development and implementation cash spending to the reinvestment deduction in OE.
audit_findings.evidence: We capitalized $ 13.8 million and $ 12.8 million of such costs during 2025 and 2024, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The spending is demonstrated, but its omission from OE is not because the record does not show whether it was already captured in property-and-equipment purchases or operating cash outflows. Even assuming both filed amounts were wholly omitted, they equal only 1.6% and 1.7% of the respective OE observations; a log-trend rerun would leave base value near $123.92 versus $101.31.
audit_findings.action: Trace the $13.8m and $12.8m by cash-flow classification and OE worksheet line, deduct any uncaptured amount once, and document whether similar historical spending was included.

audit_findings.title: GoDaddy Capital may change the business from capital-light to balance-sheet-funded
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; the filed $1.0m figure is a per-merchant advance limit, not aggregate exposure
audit_findings.mechanism: Introduces incremental working-capital funding, settlement liquidity, credit losses and reserves required to support projected growth.
audit_findings.evidence: In 2025, we launched GoDaddy Capital, a merchant cash advance program available to GoDaddy Payments users, that allows them to apply for an advance of up to $1.0 million and Instant Payouts, an on-demand payout option allowing our customers to get their payout on any day, including weekends and holidays.
audit_findings.explanation: The product launch is demonstrated, but the filings provide no aggregate advances, funding commitment, guarantee, receivable balance or credit-loss amount. Historical OE therefore cannot establish a present adjustment. The risk is chiefly forward-looking: projected growth could overstate value if it assumes software-like economics while GoDaddy funds merchant advances or accelerated payouts.
audit_findings.action: Monitor quarterly disclosures and obtain program-level originations, outstanding receivables, funding counterparties, guarantees, merchant liabilities, loss rates and liquidity needs; rerun growth reinvestment when GoDaddy-funded exposure becomes measurable.

audit_findings.title: A one-time tax benefit may remain in the OE history
audit_findings.magnitude: $34.6m in 2025; full removal would reduce the computed trend anchor by about $11.8m and base value by about $1.60/share
audit_findings.mechanism: Removes a nonrecurring tax benefit from the 2025 OE observation, lowering its weight in the log-trend anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: During 2025, we recognized a $ 34.6 million income tax benefit related to the recognition of an uncertain tax position in a foreign jurisdiction as a result of a favorable tax court ruling.
audit_findings.explanation: The one-time benefit is demonstrated, but the supplied valuation record does not establish whether it was retained in the $881.9m OE observation. Even if fully retained and removed, the trend anchor would fall from $857.7m to about $845.9m and base value from $125.14 to about $123.54 per share, still well above the $101.31 price and insufficient to change the conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Inspect the 2025 OE tax normalization for an explicit $34.6m removal; if absent, remove it and rerun the mechanical log-trend anchor and scenarios.
